Subject: Meeting 
 
Members:
The BBWAA Meeting during the Winter Meetings at 9 a.m., PST, Tuesday, Dec. 11, has been moved to Islander Ballroom D of the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino in Las Vegas.
The 2019 winner of the J.G. Taylor Spink Award for contributions to baseball writing will be announced at the meeting. The room has been booked to us for two hours.
Among the issues on the agenda are the elections of national officers.

Sent from AOL Mobile Mail

From: "Fenech, Anthony" <afenech@freepress.com>
Date: Friday, November 22, 2019 at 11:53 AM
To: "Bhatia, Peter" <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Cc: Christopher Thomas <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Meeting

I know there’s a lot on your plate with the holidays coming up, but whenever you have some time to meet, let me know. I had a lot of time to think while I was on my recent trip, and I’d like to share some of those thoughts with you and Chris, in order to best position ourselves for success going forward.
My goal for this meeting is to gain some clarity on next year’s Tigers coverage, the direction of our Sports department, and how I fit into the future at the Free Press.
I’d be open to meeting in the office or over a lunch, whichever works best and gives us the most time to talk.
